        "Fresh full signing/repackage port read. The historical transform deep-copies hardened-sign-config before keyed evaluation because evaluation can mutate the source. It asserts a primary dependency, selects production signing only for production shippable jobs, resolves per-entry entitlements by build platform/project and converts local entitlement paths to file URLs. These are exact configuration/data-flow changes, not proof the underlying signing service executed.",
        "Both repackage kinds now select notarization only for macosx64-shippable at production release level; staging and other platforms use signing. Fixed kind files retain those selected branches. The fixed comm hardened-signing module is a later wrapper after the Gecko transform and removes provisioning-profile configuration; the historical local implementation is no longer current there. Upstream transform implementation and its later evolution were not inspected.",
